summary: Gorax strongly advises all players to sign up for the Peak Gambit tournament in Magichess. The event consists of Qualifiers, Swiss Rounds split into 4-player groups, and a top 16 single-elimination Knockout Stage. Reaching the top 64 awards massive prizes, including Starweave Fragments which can be exchanged for exclusive heroes and supports. Rank 1 receives 10,000 Wyrmarrow, 300 Starweave Fragments, and exclusive cosmetics.
tips: Always sign up for the Peak Gambit tournament regardless of expected win rates to attempt securing rank rewards.
Exchange Starweave Fragments in the Temporal Corridor under Lingering Echo to get exclusive heroes and supports.
title: HUGE Rewards Are Up for Grabs! Peak Gambit Explained! | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
